name: read_file
description: Read a text file from the Godot project, optionally a specific line range. Useful for reading GDScript files, scene files, or any text-based content.

end_line.description: Inclusive end line; 0 or missing means to end of file (optional)

max_bytes.description: Stop after this many bytes. Use it on a large file rather than pulling the whole thing into context. Supported by the handler all along; it was missing from this schema.

path.description: res:// path to the file (e.g., res://scripts/player.gd)
